mentions.name: SETI@HOME-style distributed reverse engineering
mentions.description: A proposed SETI@HOME-style distributed initiative for reverse engineering proprietary firmware: contributors collectively resolve 'fat blobs', using proper caching and trust via verification so the workload can be handled in a distributed way instead of solo.
mentions.problem: Solo reverse engineering is slow and tedious, and next-generation locked-down devices mean users may not own their hardware at all.
mentions.source_excerpt: at this point I truly believe we should go in SETI@HOME style for RE if we want to survive. With a proper caching and trust via verification - a lot of fat blobs can be resolved in a distributed way. If anyone interested - ping me, it’s boring to do solo.
